rows.text: Oh! You got the hang of it immediately! This time, we specially made a space for you to have an audience with the Aeons. Let's do a test first.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Keep going and try it out. I can't promise you'll manage to meet THEM every time.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "I didn't tell you about the planes last time, so let's do that now." Herta snickers, "I was working on something else just now. As you can see, I've invited Screwllum, the great mechanical aristocrat, to this chat."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "If the Swarm Disaster is currently in its initial stage, can we infer that the birth of the Aeon of Propagation is the first plane?" A mechanical voice with elegance worthy of a king suddenly chimes in. "Greetings. It's a pleasure to see you here, {F#Ms.}{M#Mr.} [Trailblazer]."
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: It's an honor to meet you.
I miss you a lot.

"I'm glad to hear that." Screwllum says, "Your presence is akin to a butterfly that completes the scenery that brings the entire Simulated Universe alive. I look forward to the journey ahead with you."
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: "It's my honor." Screwllum says, "Your presence is akin to a butterfly that completes the scenery that brings the entire Simulated Universe alive. I look forward to the journey ahead with you."
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: "Screwllum will follow this study closely too! After all, the process of the Swarm Disaster is also closely related to inorganic beings." Herta adds, "As you can see, the three planes correspond to three different historical periods. You're now in the first plane, and that is when the Swarm has just started."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "So... there's not much action at the moment. When The Swarm starts spreading in the next plane... [Trailblazer], you'll have to pray for luck to be on your side." With an amused expression, Herta says, "Don't worry. We'll watch over you."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: So, this is the Swarm Disaster! Standing under the sky, you find your surroundings in a state of desolation. A massive swarm of mutated insects is reproducing and breaking free from their cocoons in the fields and roads around you. They devour all crops and animals until all the paths are flooded by their kinds...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You move ahead and enter a huge device. There is a platform in front of you, where a screen is showing some of the more advanced stellar systems. Some Swarms have evolved into large weapons of war there. Many vanguard units support their massive bodies with slender, armored limbs, while giant worms stand behind them as defenders. Inside the worms' round, gaping mouths are sharp teeth that give off a metallic glint.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You shudder. These insects only act according to their instincts and have no awareness. You can't help wondering about the source of this technological modification...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "[Trailblazer], I reminded you earlier that the second plane had the most insects." Herta's voice pulls your mind back to reality. "Go now. Be careful not to be caught by the Swarm and get stuck here. Don't forget you have to visit all three planes."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You snap back to reality... It's time to brace yourself and move on.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "You've reached the third plane already? This is surprisingly fast. We're traversing the entire historical Swarm Disaster at such a rapid speed." Herta glances at the glimmering sky.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Planning the development of species and nurturing them patiently until they begin to take form through a complex process — that's how a universe is created." Ruan Mei comments, "It seems like we've succeeded. The Swarm quickly spreads all over the universe, then recedes. This is in line with the rise and fall of Tayzzyronth."
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei

rows.text: "Recedes... Indeed, the Swarm did recede across the universe following the fall of Tayzzyronth!" The excitement in Herta's voice is unmistakable upon hearing the keyword. "Listen, we need to figure out why this Swarm Disaster happened. It appears that Tayzzyronth was killed in a battle among Aeons. After all, who else could have killed an Aeon? However, there is no 'appears to be' in scientific research. We need to get a thorough understanding."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "We seem to be making progress. Don't get overwhelmed." Herta's voice comes through. Unlike her usual self, she speaks seriously and seems excited about what is going to unfold. "Can you hit yourself on your head and focus? Take a closer look - we've derived Tayzzyronth."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Tayzzyronth? Everything happens so fast that you aren't ready for the change. You look up, and a beam of light flashes across the sky all of a sudden...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A peculiar cry suddenly comes from somewhere, and you are certain it is the first suckling sound of an infant insect to the air. Along with it comes the melodic tone of red butterflies sucking honey from lilies. The saliva of different scents such as the scents of orange, blood, and tropical fruits is dripping, making you feel as though you were immersed in an ocean of soda.
rows.speaker: Tayzzyronth

rows.text: You have a mild hallucination due to the ringing and chiming dust on butterfly wings that covers the sky. You find the Aeon surrounded by countless yellow butterflies, ants, meteor bugs, and hibernating insects of different sizes that are on the verge of falling. Amidst the illusion, THEY begin a continuous ascent to the sky... THEIR blood appears colorful, but you have no idea why THEY are bleeding...
rows.speaker: Tayzzyronth

rows.text: A mind-blowing phenomenon unravels before you. The Aeon's trembling body curls up timidly, as countless new insect species emerge at the same time. They exchange pheromones, just like how flowers exchange for petals of different colors. Then, an entirely new species is born.
rows.speaker: Tayzzyronth

rows.text: "As expected, it's here. This is the most prosperous period of the Path of Propagation since the creation of the universe. Cherish it, as these will be gone for good after the Aeon falls." Herta speaks softly.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "[Trailblazer], how would you feel if we stood observer to the repeating cycle where the Swarm is born, recedes, and resurges?" Herta suddenly chuckles, "It'd be quite a nice experience to watch the journey of the universe again and again."
rows.speaker: Herta
